patthana22.21:1.1: na savitakkasavicāraṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana22.21:2.1: hetuyā paṇṇarasa. napītittika nahetuduke pītittika hetudukaṃ
patthana22.21:3.1: na pītisahagataṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca pītisahagato hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana22.21:5.1: na dassanena pahātabbaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbo hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana22.21:6.1: hetuyā nava. nadassanenapahātabbahetukattika nahetuduke dassanenapahātabbahetukattika hetudukaṃ
patthana22.21:7.1: na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana22.21:9.1: na ācayagāmiṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca apacayagāmī hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana22.21:10.1: hetuyā nava. nasekkhattika nahetuduke sekkhattika hetudukaṃ
patthana22.21:11.1: na sekkhaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asekkho hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana22.21:12.1: hetuyā nava. naparittattika nahetuduke parittattika hetudukaṃ
